row.title: Merge lane pushed adoption commits straight to protected main and went red
row.body: lane.sh used git push origin HEAD:main; the main ruleset requires a PR plus the checks status, so every adoption push was declined, merge-lane liveness failed and the loop workflow stayed red. The lane now commits through tools/push_main.py (the App, exempt from the ruleset) and lane.yml has id-token: write.
